name: in-iure-app
description: App nativa Android di In Iure (Capacitor; iPhone usa la versione web da GitHub Pages) - impacchetta la web-app ../In-Iure

scripts.android:apk: node scripts/copy-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: node scripts/copy-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk-release: node scripts/copy-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
